fields.text:
Paste a scene seed. Claude Fable 5.1 writes a 180-word present-tense cold-open — no title, no moral.
Sample is the Keelung harbor switchboard (every call arrives as a smell; tonight one doesn't) so first-click Run has teeth. Swap the seed. One LLM call, reasoning low, ~$0.02.

The last analog switchboard in Keelung harbor still works. Every incoming call arrives as a smell first: diesel, pomelo peel, rain on hot tar. Tonight a call comes in with no smell at all. The operator is seventy and has never pulled a dead line.

fields.system: You write cold-opens, not morals. Present tense, close third. 160-200 words. Concrete sensory detail; no title, no preamble, no lesson, no "once upon a time". End on an image or a sound, not a summary. Reply with the scene only.
